violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - adaptive equipment and instructions (26 TAC §747.605(13)(B)(ii))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - adaptive equipment and instructions
violation_type.typical_finding: Ten children records reviewed were missing information on any adaptive equipment provided for child including instructions for how to use the equipment during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: Ten children records reviewed were missing information on any adaptive equipment provided for child including instructions for how to use the equipment during the inspection.
Three children's records evaluated were missing special care statement on file.
